strengths: Coherent neon look: cyan glowing walls, a dark checkerboard floor and a pink food pickup
Cohesive HUD with score, best and level panels, plus clean title and game-over overlays that show a 'NEW BEST!' message
Bloom glow and small particle bursts when eating and at game over
Stable run: 0 page errors and 22 foods eaten by the autopilot in 40 s
Grid and HUD adapt to a portrait phone screen
weaknesses: The wall bloom is too strong and draws the eye away from the play area
The snake is made of plain pale-teal boxes with washed-out colors and blends into the cyan floor, so it is hard to read
Food is a tiny pink disc that is hard to see; eating effects are very small and short
No visible shadows or modeled shapes; the 3D is plain boxes on a plane with a fixed high camera, and the scene around the board is empty
Failed check: Enter does not start a new game at once after game over
On a phone the board is small and the title overlay covers most of it
oneLine: A coherent neon look with a tidy HUD, but the snake and food are hard to read, the 3D is plain boxes under too much bloom, and Enter does not start a new game at once after game over, so it looks more like a styled tech demo than a finished indie game.
